At rows 34-38, the black is only at columns 14-18 — the square at columns 19-23 would stick out into the yellow cavity. So it stops at row 39.

Now, the goal: probably to bring the two squares into contact with each other (they'd meet in the central cavity area), or to move them to specific target positions.
Given that the cavity is a yellow/orange hole in the center, the goal might be to place the squares in the cavity (on top of the yellow/orange) — i.e., to make the squares "jump" into the hole? But the squares are blocked by the black boundaries... unless the squares can move onto the cavity when they're aligned with it.
Let me test: from the starting position (49,19), press RIGHT: the left square should move right to columns 24-28 if the black allows it (rows 49-53, columns 24-28: B is at columns 19-31, yes, black).
